name: sidebar
useFor: Use for an app's main navigation (agents, cards, purchases, settings). Wrap the app in SidebarProvider, put Sidebar beside SidebarInset, group rows in SidebarGroup with a label, and mark the current page with isActive. Use collapsible icon to fold it to its glyphs; it becomes a sheet on phones.
constraints: More than two levels of nesting
source: agentcard-website guides panel (.v7-guide-nav), extrapolated to an app rail
title: Sidebar
description: An app's side rail drawn as the guides' panel: quiet 14px rows, the current one on the sky wash in blue.
